summary: Two participants: CORE TEAM mr_walrus_the1st and NOT CORE TEAM Agent Steve. The thread opened with greetings and a request for event ideas. Agent Steve delivered a comprehensive catalog of WMCE event ideas, grouped by style: Competitive PvP (Hunger Games, Tournament Ladder, Capture the Flag), Roleplay/Simulation (Civilization Sim, Prison RP, Post-Apocalypse), Creative/Building (Build Contest, City Festival), Adventure/Puzzle (Escape Room, Mystery), Casual/Minigames (Mini-Game Festival, Scavenger Hunt), and Special/Novel (Survival Challenge, Economy Simulator, Charity Stream, Modded Events). For each, it listed target players, run time, required plugins/assets, and staff needs. Quick notes covered crossplay (GeyserMC), Java voice chat, scaling (Purpur vs Folia/Multipaper), hosting by Wepwawet, and rewards. It ends with an offer to flesh any idea into a full plan (timeline, plugins, maps, promos). The Core Team asked how Steve was; Steve replied and reaffirmed the planning offer.
